response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS value FROM telescope_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT t.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > b.value), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS value FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b1.value) AS mean_above_first_baseline, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b2.value) AS mean_above_second_baseline FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b1 CROSS JOIN second_baseline AS b2 WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > b2.value;
